articles.summary: New identity highlights growing demand for high-performance, commercially ready solutions to support affordable decarbonization across global fleets VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Westport Fuel Systems Inc. (“Westport" or the “company”) (TSX:WPRT / Nasdaq: WPRT), today announced that it has changed its name to Aetherion Technologies Inc. (“Aetherion”). The new name reflects the company’s sharpened focus on delivering proven, commercially ready technologies that enable affordable, lower-emission heavy-duty transportation. Heavy-duty engines move the food, medicine, construction materials and goods that keep life in motion. For more than a century, diesel has powered that work because it is powerful, proven and ubiquitous, but it is also difficult to affordably decarbonize.
